before.title: Fly Eagles Fly Sticker, Philly Football Sticker, Glossy or Holographic, Waterproof Philadelphia Decal
before.description:
This wings-and-football sticker is for the birds, for Philly fans, and for anyone who likes football or bird-watching.

Choose your finish:

Glossy: bold color with a glossy laminated finish
Holographic: sparkly, light-catching glitter

Both are waterproof and look great on a laptop, water bottle, notebook, skateboard, or anywhere else you'd like a little Philly pride.

Every sticker is drawn, designed, printed, and cut by me, who I am told is a human. No AI was used in the creation of these stickers.

Some photos are digital mockups showing the actual size. Colors and sparkle vary by screen and light.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any professional sports team or league.

Go Birds!

before.title: Philly I-76ers Highway Sign Sticker, Schuylkill Expressway Philadelphia Decal, Basketball Fan Gift, Waterproof
before.description:
Philadelphia's favorite highway meets Philadelphia's favorite team. This interstate-shield sticker is inspired by I-76 (the Schuylkill Expressway, aka the "Surekill") and Philly basketball pride, made for anyone who has sat in traffic on the way to a game.

Choose your finish:
• Glossy: glossy laminated, waterproof vinyl
• Holographic: sparkly, light-catching finish (sparkle looks different in every light)

Drawn, designed, printed, and cut by me, who I am told is a human. No AI was used in the creation of these stickers.

Some photos are digital mockups showing the actual size. Colors and sparkle vary by screen and light.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any professional sports team or league.
